questions.stem: The variance of 10 observations is 25. If 2 is multiplied to each of the observations and subsequently 7 is subtracted from each multiplied observation, then what is the new variance?
If the random variable X has mean 5 and standard deviation 4, then what is the standard deviation of the random variable Y = 3X + 4?
For a binomial distribution with mean 4 and standard deviation sqrt(3), what is the value of P(X = 0)?

Four dice are rolled. What is the probability of getting a total of the numbers on the dice as 7?
If P(A intersect B) = 1/2 and P(Abar intersect Bbar) = 1/2, and 2P(A) = P(B) = k, then what is the value of k?
A committee has 6 men and 4 women. One member is selected randomly which is woman only. What is the probability that she belongs to a subgroup of 2 senior women?
The standard deviation of X is 4 and the standard deviation of Y is 5. If the correlation coefficient r is 0.8, then what is the regression coefficient of Y on X?

In a class, the probability of passing students in Mathematics is 0.7 and the probability of passing both Mathematics and Statistics is 0.5. What is the probability that a student passes Statistics given that the student passed Mathematics?
If the mean of 50 observations is 40 and the standard deviation is 8, then what is the coefficient of variation?
If two fair dice are tossed, then what is the probability that the sum of the numbers on the faces of the dice is neither 5 nor 7?

Consider the following statements for three events A, B and C: I. P(A intersect B intersect C) <= P(A) + P(B) + P(C) - 2 II. P(A union B union C) >= P(A) + P(B) + P(C). Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

A Mathematics problem is given to two students X and Y to solve. The odds in favour of X solving the problem are 6 to 9 and the odds against Y in solving the problem are 6 to 5. What is the probability that the problem will be solved if both X and Y try to solve the problem?
The events A and B are independent among three events A, B and D. If P(A intersect B intersect D) = 0.04, P(D | A intersect B) = 0.25 and P(B) = 4P(A), then what is the value of P(A union B)?
